set.body: Public GroupContrast.difference(name, term, term) collapses its Map to a single -1 weight and estimates negative term rather than zero/refusal. GroupContrast.fromStrings returns Either but nonfinite/empty inputs throw via require; GroupDesign.twoSample can construct duplicate (Intercept) terms when that is a group label. Owner: ScalaFIM group named design/contrast constructors. Acceptance: preserve algebraic subtraction before keyed reduction; typed error for a zero/nonfinite/empty unsupported contrast; collision-safe term identities and invalid labels; valid cell means/differences unchanged; focused public-API JVM+JS regressions. Evidence: audit bd-01M20MJY5QG8F7X2ZQENTTWPD7.
set.title: Group contrasts: make named construction total and collision-safe
